resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS gives the removal date as unknown and says only the tower piers remain; the 2012 chapter report lists the site as removed in 2003. The story reports both and notes the disagreement. The 2003 date is the only dated removal in the sources read.

FFLOS dates the cabin to 1935, but newspaper items quoted on the Forest Lookouts site show a lookout post on Slate Mountain from 1914. The 1935 date most likely marks the cabin, not the first lookout.

notes_for_editor: The brief says the chapter learned of the 2003 removal afterward and believes FFLA was not informed. That sentence does not appear in the 2012 report or the pages read, so it is not used. The 2012 report's entry sits under the Eldorado National Forest heading. No fires or access details were found. The 6.1 m height is the 20-foot tower named by FFLOS; the cabin's total height is not given.
